messages.subject: Error: Cannot open the connection
parts:
I have an Shiny app (interactive document) that runs on within RStudio.  It uploaded without errors (at least that I noticed).  However, when I try to run it from shinyapps.io (https://rmacey.shinyapps.io/FlexibleAA) I get an "Error: Cannot open the connection".  I'd appreciate any ideas. Here are some of the issues that come to my mind:

While not a large document or app, there is a lot of processing.  Perhaps there is a time-out?
It uses getSymbols() from the Quantmod package...perhaps there is a connection issue there (but I've seen other apps use this I think).  
I don't know what I'm doing (this should probably be first). 

I am not saving anything to disk.  

Thank you.
